behavior: Social and often colonial; flies over shallow water and plunge-dives for small fish and crustaceans, then gathers in flocks to rest on open shores.
field_marks: Shaggy black crown or rear crest, depending on season
Short black legs and dark eyes
Long pointed wings and a forked tail
habitat: Warm coastal marine waters, especially shallow bays, lagoons, and estuaries; rests and nests on open sandy beaches and low-lying islands.
